← Slovenščina

Native check: Slovenščina

Native speaker? Each line below is from the book. Read it and its question, then choose Correct if it is fine as it is, Needs change if it is not (and write how you would say it), or Not sure. Answer as many lines as you like.

Round 9 of 14. After you send, the next round has more lines.

You don't need to have read the book. The grey lines above each line show what comes just before it; only the line marked at the side is being checked.

  • Maman (mother), Baba (father) and -jan after a name (dear) are kept from Persian on purpose, like other Persian words such as beit and ghazal.
  • Some characters swear, speak crudely or mispronounce words on purpose; the question says so when it matters.
Line 1

upanja na tvojo vrnitev nimam

a če te pot zanese mimo

pridi spet v moje sanje

His closing poem asks her to come into his dreams one more time. Does this line say that, as poetry?

Line 2

a če te pot zanese mimo

pridi spet v moje sanje

zdi se mi, da moje sanje niso verjele, da si odšla

The last line of his poem to the girl he lost. Does it read as poetry?

Line 3

luč mojih sanj mežika

upanja na tvojo vrnitev nimam

a če te pot zanese mimo

His poem: but if your path should bring you near. Does this line say that, as poetry?

Line 4

zdaj si odšla

luč mojih sanj mežika

upanja na tvojo vrnitev nimam

His poem to the girl he lost: he holds no hope of her return. Does this line read as poetry?

Line 5

Moje sanje so bile temne

Nič nisem videl

Prišla si

Svetloba mojih sanj ... svetloba mojih sanj se je ... svetloba mojih sanj se je prižgala

He tries out his poem, stumbling and restarting a line. Does the halting repetition read naturally?

Line 6

Prišla si

Svetloba mojih sanj ... svetloba mojih sanj se je ... svetloba mojih sanj se je prižgala

Zdaj ... zdaj ... zdaj tebe ni več ...

He falters as he tries out the end of his poem. Does this halting line sound natural?

Line 7

Prišla si

svetilka mojih sanj se je prižgala

zdaj si odšla

His poem: you came, the light of my dreams turned on, now you are gone. Does this line read as poetry?

Line 8

Na vse zapisuj

razen na vodo

in če prečkaš morje

The poem on the blackboard: and if you cross the sea. Does this line read as poetry?

Line 9

Sajad je zaprl prenosnik in zakričal:

Jebenec. Objektivno, dolar bo kmalu 1500 tomanov, ti pa se ubaduješ s tistim nesrečnežem?

Sajad, who says 'Objektivno' all the time, scolds a roommate for pestering someone. Does this sound natural?

Line 10

Sedel sem na postelji in razmišljal o majhni rumeni sponki za lase, ki sem jo tisti dan prvič videl v Niloofarnih laseh. Sajad je preklinjal hitrost interneta.

Naloži že, jebenec.

Sajad swears at the slow internet while he waits. Does this sound natural?

Line 11

Farid je rekel:

Preklet bodi, kdor zanika Orlov Pogled News.

Farid mock-solemnly curses anyone who doubts Sajad, the room's gossip source, nicknamed Eagle Eye News. Does this sound playful?

Line 12

Farid je rekel:

Ahhh. Meso mi je opadlo.

Farid, squeamish at a violent video, says it made his skin crawl. Does this read as being squeamish?

Line 13

In zliva smeh na smeh.

Puf, ampak prekleto, spakiral si se in odšel tja, zdaj pa sediš in se smejiš naši bradi in našemu kurcu.

Hooman teases Amir crudely for leaving Iran and laughing at the friends left behind. Does this sound natural?

Line 14

Rekel sem:

– Stari tu Stari?

Hooman je rekel:

Pošljite salavat. Starešina Krčme je končno nekaj rekel.

Hooman mocks quiet Amir as if a miracle happened: the Elder finally spoke. Does this tease sound natural?

Line 15

– Takšne morilske poteze so ti čisto podobne,

a res me zanima, kateri prasec je odprl trgovino ob šestih zjutraj v petek, da si šel in od njega kupil fotoaparat.

Hooman wonders crudely what maniac had a shop open at six on a Friday morning. Does this sound natural?

Line 16

Hooman je rekel:

Toliko se učiš, pa se na koncu z najino zasrano srečo vseeno izteče takole.

Hooman complains crudely about their rotten luck despite all their studying. Does this sound natural?
